items.quote: LightRAG write-side LLM spend is metered: corpus-delete.json and the full-delete part declare calls_llm, the v1 driver returns token usage for ingest and delete when v1 records it, and full-ingest/full-delete report counted_by other than 'unbudgetable' when usage is present
The full-ingest and full-delete admission records number CONTRACT §8 conditions correctly: network-namespace isolation and token unbudgetability are recorded under condition 3
GET /health performs no writes: on a fresh, empty store_root it creates no files or directories
GET /health reports only facts it checked: stores.vector reflects an actual Faiss index probe or is reported as not probed; an empty or unused store_root is not reported 'ok'
eval corpus_ingest --spend --arm lightrag writes only to the eval store (v1/.eval_corpus_store or the configured eval working dir), never to the operator corpus v1/.corpus_working_dir
Querying a LightRAG arm whose vector namespace (chunks, entities, relationships) has never been populated returns a named refusal or an explicit 'namespace empty' signal in the envelope

LightRAG hybrid/local/global answers are generated from KG context as in v1 kg_query: the assembled prompt includes the budgeted entity and relation descriptions (budget-entities/budget-relations) as well as chunks
LightRAG retrieval matches v1 ordering and selection: entity-lookup searches with the low-level keyword string and relation-lookup with the high-level keyword string
Query traces for the naive/hybrid/local/global LightRAG arms contain no no-op embedder-index node
The v1 driver ops 'entities' (entity map for a document_id) and 'entity_info' (entity details by name) are either reachable through an engine method plus REST route and MCP tool
